changes: No substantive changes. The first reading's persons, roles, relation, undated status, place and purpose all match the text.
Notes expanded: the dūtaka's name Udayadeva is only Regmi's restoration of a lacuna, so confidence stays low. Line 1 is also lost, so a mahāsāmanta title cannot be checked.

purpose: Royal edict on a stone slab (śilāpaṭṭakaśāsana) granting a concession (prasāda) to the householders (kuṭumbinaḥ) of a village; the content of the grant is lost.
notes: The dūtaka's name after [yuvarā]jaśrī is lost; only Regmi restores [udayadevaḥ], so the identification as Udayadeva has low confidence. Line 1 is lost, so it cannot be checked whether Aṃśuvarman is styled mahāsāmanta here. The village name and the content of the prasāda (ll. 5–6) are in lacunae. The date portion at the end is worn away. Concordance: Gn. XLIV; DV 86; HJ 90; R. 81.
